source_findings.asset-installation: AssetSegmentEvent extends ActualEvent. Asset and Segment are each structurally optional. The publisher’s Scenario 11 requires the asset, location and event time for that use case. Do not generalize the scenario’s required content to every core-schema instance.
source_findings.measurement-location: MeasurementLocation can identify a physical or virtual position on an asset or segment; it can identify a collection source address and transducer orientation. MeasurementSource is a collector or monitoring system. The three roles can differ.
source_findings.model-variant: ModelVariant uses parent and child models to represent a hierarchy of configurable variants. ModelRevision is a separate schema type. AssetModelEvent records past associations; current Model is a direct Asset link.
source_findings.work: WorkOrder collects requests and steps. Request, calendared work, active work and completed work are distinct representations. CompletedWork identifies actual work and can record used or removed resources.
source_findings.causality: ActualEvent may be substantiated by Measurement, optionally with ByAgent. ProposedEvent and HypotheticalEvent separately represent an explanatory hypothesis and a possible failure mode represented in an engineering study.
source_findings.reliability: RemainingLifeAssessment carries Estimate, Error and Confidence. LifecycleStatusHistory identifies the entity, required status type and optional status start date.

candidate_tests.candidate: Time-qualified assignment of an identified asset to a functional location
candidate_tests.source: XSD/CCOM.xsd: AssetSegmentEvent, ActualEvent, TimestampedEvent; OIIE Scenario 11
candidate_tests.reason: The existing rows distinguish slots, current occupancy, replaceability and matching. An installation or removal history can record the same equipment in successive places even when it is no longer present at the original location.

candidate_tests.candidate: Measurement location is independently identifiable from asset, functional location and collector
candidate_tests.reason: The model can identify a physical or virtual point where measurements are taken, independently of the source reporting them. Test against the existing measurement-point identifier row before adding.

candidate_tests.candidate: Current product model and dated model-assignment history
candidate_tests.source: XSD/CCOM.xsd: Asset.Model, AssetModelEvent, TimestampedEvent, ModelVariant, ModelRevision
candidate_tests.reason: The current model and model assignment history are differently modeled. A revision or variant hierarchy alone supplies no chronology for assigned models.

candidate_tests.candidate: Maintenance request through completed work and equipment-event linkage
candidate_tests.source: XSD/CCOM.xsd: Request, WorkOrder, WorkStep, CompletedWork, TimestampedEvent
candidate_tests.reason: A recommended action or ordered step does not prove execution. The model can link performed work and related asset events, independently of work planning.

candidate_tests.candidate: Evidence for actual event and competing explanations
candidate_tests.source: XSD/CCOM.xsd: ActualEvent, SubstantiatedByMeasurement, ProposedEvent, HypotheticalEvent, AmbiguitySet
candidate_tests.reason: An event can carry a measurement as supporting evidence. A diagnostic proposal or hypothetical failure mode has different standing from the actual logged occurrence.
